summary: Ironstone Lookout on Willoughby Ridge in the Crowsnest Pass: an observer was on duty in June 2015, a June 2022 hiker found it not manned, and no build date was found.

access.note: Reached on foot by road and trail from the York Creek staging area; no source says whether the buildings are open to visitors

visit.trail_note: 12 km round trip with 550 m of ascent from the York Creek staging area south of Coleman (2022 hike report)

events.note: Lookout observer Steve met a June 2015 visitor; it was his fifth season on the job
June 2022 hiker found the lookout did not seem manned that day

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Sources name the summit Willoughby Peak or Willoughby Ridge; Spirko places the lookout on the higher south summit of the ridge
A June 2015 visit met an observer on duty; a June 2022 visit found the lookout did not seem manned that day. Each is a single visit, so neither shows current staffing

notes_for_editor: No build date, builder, height or agency appears in any source read, so the story leaves them out. The only structure description is the 2022 hike report (watch tower, antenna, buildings). The brief says access is unknown; trail accounts show a public hike, but the buildings' status is open, so the access level deserves a human look. Brief status 'standing' fits the 2015 and 2022 accounts, but no 2026 source confirms condition or staffing. Elevation is not used: Hiking With Par gives 2079 m for the objective and on-top.ca gives 2073 m for Willoughby Ridge. The brief's source page (OpenStreetMap way 1430038047) was not read. Search budget: three searches (one over the two-per-tower budget) and about seven page reads.
